remarks: Welcome to 227 Mill Street. This completely redesigned and thoughtfully renovated turn-key home offers modern updates, flexible living spaces and the potential for additional income. First floor features include 4 bedrooms and 2.5 beautiful bathrooms, a spacious living room, family room and a convenient main-level laundry. The highest quality finishes and extensive renovations are showcased throughout. The stunning eat-in kitchen features beautiful new cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a center island and a separate dining area. A spacious living room offers an open, inviting experience with cathedral ceilings and sliding glass doors leading to the backyard, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The fully renovated second-floor apartment or in-law suite provides excellent flexibility and potential income, featuring its own kitchen, living room, dining area, 2 bedrooms and full bathroom, along with new stainless steel appliances. The extensive capital enhancements include a new architectural roof, vinyl siding, windows, flooring, insulation, drywall and paint, hot water tanks and so much. Outside, you will find a beautiful wooded lot with two driveways providing ample off-street parking and a large shed offers additional storage. A truly breathtaking transformation, 227 Mill Street is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready home with versatile living spaces and income potential. Come enjoy all this impressive property has to offer!
